paragraphs: The stock price of Fermi Inc. is 6.12, with a change of -4.45% compared to the prior close and 1.07% over a window of 22 sessions. The price is as of 2026-08-17.

There have been 3 new news articles in the last 24 hours, all of which report on Fermi receiving a subpoena from a US District Court for documents related to the Project Matador data center campus. The news articles are from Seeking Alpha, Blockonomi, and Seeking Alpha on MSN, and all were published on 2026-08-17.

There have been various SEC filings recently, including a 10-Q form, a SCHEDULE 13G/A form, and multiple 8-K forms. One of the 8-K forms reports the appointment of Lee McIntire as the new Chief Executive Officer, effective August 11, 2026, with an annualized base salary of $750,000. There has been 1 Form 4 filing and 9 new social posts in the last 24 hours.
